🥚 EGG MAYHEM: MODDED 🥚

Every egg holds a surprise. Crack open a collection of wild pets, build your dream base, and see how long you can protect your best finds.
🎲 Roll for eggs with unexpected looks and abilities
🐲 Raise tiny companions into collection stars
🏠 Customize your base and show off your rarest pets
💨 Boost your speed to chase down a prize—or escape with one
🕹️ Open the admin panel and turn the server upside down
👀 Keep an eye on your collection. Other players are watching!

What’s hiding in your next egg?
